title: What age range did you start having dreams in this shared space?
content: If you'd like you can post your current age/age range in the comments, or whatever you'd like :) The youngest age range is ages 2-5 as that's the general consensus of when we start dreaming, so if you remember a mall world dream from that age range, I'm extremely curious on details if you're comfortable sharing here or in PM! The following age ranges are based on standard maturity, puberty, and typical ranges seen in studies. Reddit won't let me add more than 6 options, if you started having dreams later than age 35, please post below :) Edit to add: if you're underage, please do not post your actual age for safety!
